_comment: Copy to x9/build/local.json (gitignored). Every input lives under the repository: relative paths resolve against the repo root (layout in NOTES.md, Build section). Only developer_dir, llvm_clang, lld, homebrew and compiler_launcher point at compile tools outside it. dxb selects the XNU object tree: .local/dxb (macOS kext ABI, proven boots) or .local/dxb-iosabi (iOS kext ABI, needed for the prelinked original USB kexts).
